items.title: Will Shade and Dewey Corley Interview, 1960-05-25
items.q: Ben Ramey played Kazoo. Also, I played guitar... Memphis Jug Band.

ctx.x: He played Jug. Mm-hmm. Ben Ramey played Kazoo. Also, I played guitar. A double, I played harmonica two. Will Welton, he played second guitar. And I played lead. And wrote my own songs. Made up my own tunes. What was that guy's, what was the name of that group? Memphis Jug Band. Mm-hmm. Did you make any records with those fellas? I made that my first record, I made it up to the first record, I made it up to the
first time. And what was the tunes on that record?
